names.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gargantia_on_the_Verdurous_Planet : 'Onderia'; https://suisei-no-gargantia.fandom.com/wiki/Onderia (page title). Variant page https://suisei-no-gargantia.fandom.com/wiki/Ondelia also exists (the Kugel-cult priestess).

Fan-wiki body text sometimes writes 'Bevel'; the page title and Wikipedia use Bebel.
Unit class (mass-produced Alliance mecha), used as a common noun in prose.

names.source: https://suisei-no-gargantia.fandom.com/wiki/Ryan : 'Ryan' (Evolver-era man turned first-generation Hideauze, wife Eida, daughter Elaine); https://www.angryanimebitches.com/2013/06/suisei-no-gargantia-episode-9-shocking-revealation/ : 'Ryan Matsumoto'

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: 少年 (boy), 16 years old; Wikipedia 'Sixteen-year-old Ensign Ledo'; fan wiki infobox Male
characters.nickname: Melty calls him 'handsome guy' (イケメン); no proper nickname
characters.position: second lieutenant (少尉; Wikipedia says ensign) of the Galactic Alliance of Humankind, Machine Caliber pilot; later a salvager living in the Gargantia Fleet
characters.personality: blank-faced and poor at expressing emotion because he knows only combat; wary, blunt and very observant; gradually opens up in the fleet

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: autonomous AI (自律型ＡＩ), no pronoun. Wikipedia calls Chamber 'masculine' and the voice is male (Tomokazu Sugita), but it is a machine; the library English refers to it as 'it'
characters.nickname: 'Tin Can' (ブリキ野郎), used by Pinion
characters.position: pilot support and enlightenment interface system of Ledo's Machine Caliber; his partner, adviser and translator
characters.personality: rational, formal and literal, dryly loyal to its pilot; follows Ledo's judgment; grows attached to him

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: 少女 (girl), 15 years old; Wikipedia: 'A 15-year-old messenger'; fan wiki Female
characters.position: messenger (courier) of the Gargantia Fleet; Ledo's first friend and guide; elder sister of Bebel
characters.personality: curious, active and always cheerful; kind-hearted and brave; skilled with kites and gliders

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: 少女 (girl), 15; Wikipedia: 'Amy's friend and a reserved 15-year-old messenger'
characters.position: messenger of the Gargantia Fleet; one of the trio with Amy and Melty
characters.personality: easygoing and laid-back, but sharp about money; glamorous figure

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: 少女 (girl), 14; Wikipedia: 'A hyper 14-year-old messenger'
characters.nickname: calls Ledo 'handsome guy' (イケメン); no nickname of her own
characters.position: messenger of the Gargantia Fleet; the youngest of the three friends
characters.personality: childish and eager to act grown-up; loves good-looking boys and romance gossip but has no experience; lively

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: 少女 (girl), 18; Wikipedia 'The 18-year-old leader'; fan wiki Female
characters.position: head of the fleet's salvage team (hauls up materials of the old civilization); salvaged Chamber and handed it to Pinion
characters.personality: strict big-sister type (姉御肌) about work but deeply trusted by her crew; skilled with the Yunboro; often argues with Pinion

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: 女性 (woman), 22; Wikipedia 'she takes over as Fleet Commander'
characters.position: aide to Fleet Commander Fairlock; named his successor and becomes fleet commander
characters.personality: serious, calm, rational and responsible; also stiff and inflexible, so some avoid her; learns to rely on others

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: 青年 (young man), 20; DSC2: 'he had his older brother killed'; Wikipedia: 'His older brother was killed'
characters.nickname: calls Chamber 'Tin Can'; no nickname of his own
characters.position: head of the fleet's machine repair and maintenance work and side salvager; later founds and leads the Pinion Fleet
characters.personality: flippant and ambitious, dreams of striking it rich; reliable skill with machines; fairly popular; bickers with Bellows

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: 弟 (younger brother) of Amy, 少年 (boy); Wikipedia: 'Amy's 10-year-old little brother ... he'
characters.position: Amy's younger brother, a bedridden boy under Dr. Oldham's care; no fleet post
characters.personality: sharp, cheerful and kind despite his illness; well-read; hobby is building model sailing ships from scrap

characters.gender_evidence: Wikipedia: 'his death', 'he passes away' (fleet commander Fairlock, voiced by Hideaki Tezuka); fan wiki infobox Male. The Japanese DSCR uses no pronoun
characters.position: Fleet Commander (船団長) of the Gargantia Fleet; ill and uses a wheelchair; appoints Ridget his successor before dying
characters.personality: experienced, always calm, puts the fleet's safety first; cares for Ridget like a parent

characters.gender_evidence: Wikipedia: 'A major shipleader ... secedes ... his efforts ... he is forced to join'; fan wiki Male; voice Eizo Tsuda. The Japanese DSCR uses no pronoun
characters.position: one of the major ship owners (大船主) of the Gargantia Fleet, part of its leadership with Fairlock; later leaves with Pinion
characters.personality: treats Ledo and Chamber as a nuisance at first; pragmatic and treasure-hungry; later a collaborator, then a rebel against Kugel's fleet

characters.gender_evidence: Fan wiki infobox Male; voiced by Mitsuaki Hoshino (Japanese) and Kyle Hebert (English). The Japanese DSCR and Wikipedia use no pronoun
characters.position: major ship owner second to Flange, one of the leaders of the Gargantia Fleet; stays with the fleet
characters.personality: level-headed and loyal to the fleet; supports Ridget's appointment for the sake of the next generation

characters.gender_evidence: Fan wiki infobox Male ('Dr. Oldham'); voiced by Hideyuki Umezu. The Japanese DSCR (老医師) uses no pronoun
characters.position: the fleet's old doctor and Bebel's physician; runs a library atop a tower; knows of the hidden mass driver
characters.personality: gentle, well-read, loved by everyone on the fleet

characters.gender_evidence: Wikipedia: pirate leader, 'her men'; fan wiki Female, 19 years old; voice Ayumi Tsunematsu. The Japanese DSCR gives no pronoun
characters.nickname: 'Great Pirate Lukkage' (大海賊ラケージ); the series calls her the pirate empress / queen
characters.position: leader of the pirate fleet that attacks the Gargantia; later part of Kugel's fleet, then rebels and joins the Gargantia Fleet
characters.personality: flamboyant, commanding, vicious and always confident; excellent at battle command; feared even by rough pirates

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: 少女 (girl); fan wiki Female
characters.position: attendant and co-pilot of Lukkage; fights alongside Parinuri in combat gear
characters.personality: loyal servant; the library gives no more (fan wiki: blonde young woman)

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: 少女 (girl); fan wiki Female
characters.position: attendant and co-pilot of Lukkage; fights alongside Paraem in combat gear
characters.personality: loyal servant; the library gives no more (fan wiki: dark-blue-haired young woman)

characters.gender_evidence: Wikipedia: 'He eventually dies' (voiced by Yuki Ono); fan wiki infobox Male. The Japanese DSCR uses no pronoun
characters.position: lieutenant colonel (中佐) of the Alliance forces, commander of the Machine Caliber pilots and Ledo's superior; later leader of the Kugel Fleet on Earth
characters.personality: excellent commander leading his unit against the Hideauze; strong-willed and militaristic; knew all along that the Hideauze are human

characters.gender_evidence: AI. Wikipedia describes Striker as a 'feminine robot' and the fan wiki lists Female (AI) with a female voice (Ayumi Fujimura); the Japanese DSCR gives no pronoun
characters.position: pilot support and enlightenment interface of the command-type Machine Caliber Kugel boards; after Kugel's death it rules the Kugel Fleet

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: 巫女 (shrine maiden / priestess), a female role; fan wiki Female
characters.position: priestess (巫女) serving Kugel, in a position to govern the fleet
characters.personality: fervently devoted to Kugel; authoritative

characters.gender_evidence: Fan wiki infobox Male (Ryan, husband of Eida, father of Elaine); the Japanese DSCR gives no pronoun
characters.position: man in the video records left in the whalesquid nest (Evolvers era); a test subject of the experiment to adapt humans to vacuum, one of the first Hideauze
characters.personality: not characterized in the library

left_pending: ラケージ・ユンボロ: glossary 'Rackage Yunboro' is official and is not overridden; case is in challenges (name not listed in names)
challenges: ラケージ・ユンボロ: glossary 'Rackage Yunboro' (akurasu_z3.2_mech_list) should be 'Lukkage Yunboro'. The same wiki's pilot database names the unit 'Lukkage Yunboro' (work/glossary/reference/sources/akurasu_z3.2_pilot_database.wiki, Lukkage section), the akurasu series page spells 'Lukkage' / 'Lukage Yunboro' (https://akurasu.net/wiki/Gargantia_on_the_Verdurous_Planet), and Wikipedia and the franchise wiki spell the character Lukkage (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gargantia_on_the_Verdurous_Planet ; https://suisei-no-gargantia.fandom.com/wiki/Pirate_Queen_Lukkage : 'also known as Rackage'). Pilot ラケージ is settled as 'Lukkage'; unit and pilot should match.
uncertain: Shared Avalon: Gargantia keyword 35 and the Code Geass flying fortress both use the token アヴァロン; both official English forms are 'Avalon', so no retoken is needed unless the Geass group settles a different form. Geass pilots 416 and 420 use $$アヴァロン$$ in prose.

Chamber full name: the pilot record follows akurasu 'K6821 Chamber' (serial first); the robot record and Wikipedia use 'Chamber K6821'. Striker is 'Striker X3752' in both (no akurasu form). Recommend unifying on the series order 'Chamber K6821' for the pilot too if consistency matters more than wiki precedence.
ヒディアーズ#keyword vs #robot: both 'Hideauze'; the split token is unnecessary but harmless.
霧の海 = 'Sea of Mist' rests on one franchise-wiki page (Kugel); not confirmed in a licensed release. 'Sea of Fog' is the literal alternative.
ユンボロイド: 'Yunboroid' is proposed only (formal Japanese name; no English source found). ユンボロ 'Yunboro' is solid.
マツモト / ライアン・マツモト: surname Matsumoto comes from fan episode recaps (AngryAnimeBitches, Boron Heist), not a licensed source; kept 'proposed'.

Gender of Fairlock, Flange, Crown, Oldham, Kugel: no Japanese description gives a pronoun; male comes from Wikipedia pronouns (Fairlock, Flange, Kugel) and from the fan-wiki infobox plus male voice actors (Crown, Oldham). Prose should avoid pronouns for them unless the scene settles it.
Chamber and Striker are machines: gender 'not applicable'. The series gives Chamber a male voice and Striker a female one; keep 'it' in library text as the existing English does.

Onderia (オンデリア): the game calls her Kugel's priestess who governs the fleet; the fan wiki has two pages (Onderia as pirate half-sister of Linaria, Ondelia as member of Kugel's cult fleet), probably the same character. Spelling Onderia chosen from Wikipedia; her anime role is thinly documented.
Pilot 465: the game says 少尉 (second lieutenant); Wikipedia says 'ensign'. Same lowest officer rank; library English already says second lieutenant.
The Jigoku glossary has no Gargantia entries, so nothing from that file.
Fan-wiki pages were read from web.archive.org copies (the site blocks direct fetch); text saved in the scratchpad gargantia folder.
